The left chart has a vertical axis labeled "% des BIP" ranging from 0 to 3.5, with a horizontal axis spanning from 1991 to 2023. The chart features stacked bars in blue (Bund), purple (Länder), and green (Gemeinden). The right chart has a vertical axis labeled "% des BIP" ranging from -0.5 to 3.5, with a horizontal axis spanning from 1991 to 2023. The chart features a black line representing Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt, which fluctuates between approximately -0.5 and 1.5. 

Both charts have a vertical dashed line labeled "Bahnreform" and an arrow pointing to it. The charts display data for each year, with no apparent sorting or highlighting of specific bars. The colors used are blue, purple, green, and black.
